description: H¹ timeline over the documented 1997-98 contagion chronology. Settles notes/25's open either/or: within the model H¹ is a COINCIDENT contagion meter, not a leading indicator — it never moves before the 1997-07 onset. The time-derivative-predictability hypothesis is retired (its validation target, the lag trend, was withdrawn).
honest_limits: Trust levels are author-assigned (b); only the event ORDERING is (c)-grade chronology. The conclusion is about the model's logical structure: even granting the assignments, the leading reading does not follow. A real leading-indicator test would need a pre-crisis observable (e.g. short-term external debt ratios) mapped to Trust — future work, and notes/25 §3.1's '見かけは安定' hints at it but no such input exists in the model today.
